newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK Q1 INSURANCE UNIT PREMIUMS 50.5 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK Q1 INSURANCE UNIT PREMIUMS 50.5 MLN EEK.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank said on Monday that the insurance premiums of its Eesti Kindlustus subsidiary were 50.49 million kroons in the first quarter, of which 18.6 million kroons were collected in March.
Some 80 percent of the premiums came from general insurance and 20 percent from life insurance.
It said that insurance premiums in the first quarter rose by 1.3 times compared with the same period of 1996.
It said that in March it paid out 7.6 million kroons in claims, of which of which 6.3 million kroons was paid on general insurance and the rest on life insurance.
The premiums in March were 1.3 times higher than in February, it added.
The company said that the average payout in March was 41.2 percent and that it was 39.1 percent in the first quarter. some 11 percent lower than the first quarter of last year.
